description: Reusable authored-pose direction for summoner player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies grimoire-and-circle invocation choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: ritualistic, precise, receptive, and flowing, with careful grimoire handling, circular hand paths, and visible control of ethereal wisps
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's robes, grimoire, orbs, jewelry, and exact familiar or wisp count. Keep exactly one depicted book or focus and never duplicate pages, orbs, wisps, or permanent accessories.
identity.magicRule: Summoning effects use the portrait's established palette and form one compact circle, aperture, or wisp cluster. Do not create a full creature identity in the pose atlas; keep effects secondary to the summoner's body and hands.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, robes, grimoire, orbs, wisps, jewelry, palette, proportions, and equipment. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact mystical silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered summoner in a receptive ritual stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall summoner motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, robes, grimoire, palette, proportions, orbs, and wisp count. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A quiet attunement loop alternates breath, a careful page or focus check, and small receptive hand movements while wisps remain contained.
idle.effectRule: Existing wisps or orbs may drift through a tiny closed loop; no new summon or open portal.
frameDescriptions: receptive ready stance with grimoire or focus controlled
gentle inhale as existing wisps rise
weight shifts forward during a careful page or focus check
free hand traces a small closed guiding curve
centered attuned midpoint
soft exhale as wisps descend
weight shifts rearward while the hand closes
receptive stance flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A measured alternating walk protects the grimoire or focus through contacts, passing poses, robe movement, and contained wisp follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No active summon; established wisps follow closely without changing count.
frameDescriptions: left foot forward contact with focus protected
left leg compresses as robes gather
passing pose with right knee advancing
right foot reaches while free hand balances
right foot forward contact

passing pose with left knee advancing

attack.motionDirection: A target lock becomes a circular hand cue, compact wisp compression, short directed strike, curving return, and restored attunement.
attack.effectRule: Direct only the existing wisp cluster or one compact sigil toward close range; do not add a creature, duplicate a wisp, or obscure the summoner.

existing wisps compress beside the established focus

hurt.motionDirection: An impact breaks concentration into a flinch, scattered-but-counted wisp recoil, protective focus clutch, low brace, and careful re-attunement.
hurt.effectRule: Existing wisps may scatter slightly but must retain exact count; no gore, blood, extra summon, or full portal.
frameDescriptions: receptive guard before impact
sharp flinch with focus drawn close
maximum stagger as existing wisps spread apart
stumbling rear step while protecting the grimoire

death.motionDirection: Attunement breaks, wisps fade, knees buckle, the body curls protectively around the focus, collapses sideways, and settles fully fallen.
death.effectRule: Wisps fade without spawning a creature, gore, blood, explosion, or rigid rotation; retain all permanent equipment.

existing wisps dim as the focus lowers

cast.motionDirection: The focus opens, one hand traces a circle, wisps mark its boundary, a compact aperture forms, responds to a command, closes, and leaves the summoner composed.
cast.effectRule: Create one compact summoning circle or aperture in the established palette without depicting a full creature; keep hands, focus, and feet visible.

hand traces a clear circular boundary

maximum compact aperture held under control

composed attuned casting finish

victory.motionDirection: The summoner confirms victory, lifts the focus, guides existing wisps through a celebratory orbit, closes the book or hand cue, and holds serene command.
victory.effectRule: Existing wisps may form one compact celebratory ring; do not change count or open a full portal.
